content.comment_body: Hi everyone, I'm encountering issues after purchasing a starter pack that includes a [product_name] without a display ([article_no]) and the [product_name] operator device. The only item provided for connection was an Ethernet cable. I'm unsure how to transfer the program I created to the [product_name]. I have tried searching and following advice from previous posts, but nothing has worked so far. When I select Ethernet and click refresh, an IP address appears, but I get an error stating it's unable to connect. Any assistance is appreciated.

Hello [user_name], Welcome to the forum. To get started: 1.) Make sure all devices ([product_name], operator device, and your PC/laptop) are set to the same IP address range, such as 192.168.000.xxx, where each device has a unique xxx value. The subnet mask should be identical on each device, for example: 255.255.255.000. You only need to specify a gateway address if connecting through a gateway, like a router—then use the router's IP as the gateway address. Example: Router: IP = 192.168.000.001, subnet mask = 255.255.255.000 PC/Laptop: IP = 192.168.000.010, subnet mask = 255.255.255.000 [product_name]: IP = 192.168.000.003, subnet mask = 255.255.255.000, gateway = 192.168.000.001 [product_name]: IP = 192.168.000.004, subnet mask = 255.255.255.000, gateway = 192.168.000.001 2.) For the [product_name] and operator device to communicate, enter the [product_name]'s address details in the operator device's configuration, accessible in its main menu. 3.) When creating a program for [product_name], ensure you select the correct hardware version in the software setup—choose [version_no] for the new model.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing difficulty transferring a program from a PC to a [product_name] device included in a starter pack with no display. The main issues reported involve network configuration and a lack of clear instructions, leading to connection errors even after following existing online resources.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want a simple, reliable process for downloading and transferring programs from a PC to the [product_name] device via Ethernet, with clear step-by-step guidance provided in the available documentation or online support.
